quoted.T2:13:0: "It was like somebody had closed all my tabs. All forty. … I was a bit scared to move. In case they all came back. … And then I looked at my phone to check the time and they all came back."
quoted.T2:21:0: "Envious isn't quite it. It's like watching a party through a window. And I've chosen the window. … But I've chosen the window, and I keep choosing it."
quoted.T2:7:0: "I thought, this is my job. This is literally my job. Something's broken, it's urgent, and I'm on call. … And I laughed. … Despairing and funny at the same time."
